title: nerv-planner-v1: model-layer cases on Misato's own tool index, Italian and English
goal: A model is given nerv's real tool index and its decision is checked, so a model change or a tool-index change is measured
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposal from coordinator:F-016, docs/reviews/2026-11-shared-assets/gauntlet-nerv.md); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".

evals/gauntlet/nerv-planner-v1.json (pack nerv-planner) exists: model layer, regression and holdout splits, invented data, exact-json on the decision and its required arguments (json-match once gauntlet-protocol releases it); built from evals/gauntlet/nerv-planner-v1.cases.json by tools/gauntlet-planner-pack.mjs over the real planner prompt (misatoAsk) and tool index; consumed through evals/gauntlet/consumption.json nervModelPacks

Cases cover reminders (relative times counted from when the owner asked, as in B-143), memory facts, write tools proposed for the owner's approval card, a switched-off pack's tool never chosen, Grover's read-only MCP tools, and requests no granted tool can do answered with a reply or an ask; each as an Italian and an English request over the real tool list
A test fails when a case names a tool the index does not register or does not offer (test/gauntlet-planner.test.mjs)
The first owner-approved run moved to F-120-T13 (owner decision) and F-120-T14 (agent run and ledger entry), one actor per step
Feeds F-126, F-106, F-113 (before and after), B-143, F-082, F-083, F-121 and F-132
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: Any --allow-models run of nerv-planner needs the owner (F-120-T13); a material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: From coordinator:F-016-T03 proposal 1; Italian and English requests for every scenario (owner 2026-11-26). Done 2026-11-26: pack builder, 36 cases, wiring and failing-first tests; the owner's first-run part moved to F-120-T13.

prs.note: nerv-planner pack, wiring and failing-first tests; no real model run
